exposure: Preeclampsia with acute worsening requiring termination (n=7)
outcome: Interval between diagnosis and pregnancy termination
cohort: Pregnant women divided into three groups: uncomplicated pregnancies, preeclampsia without emergency termination, and preeclampsia with acute worsening requiring termination
finding: Placental Annexin A2 mRNA expression was significantly higher in women with acute worsening of preeclampsia compared to those with uncomplicated pregnancies.
birth_weight: Significantly lower in the group with acute worsening of preeclampsia compared to the normal group
